category_definitions.fat_winner: positive saved net and saved MFE >= 3R
category_definitions.immediate_fail: negative saved net and hold <= 2 parent bars
category_definitions.mfe_giveback: nonpositive saved net after saved MFE >= 1R

clock_limitation: Reconstruct saved parent array-grouped 15m timestamps exactly for diagnosis only; source clock is not authority for UTC-aligned new child. No source history economics are rerun.
mechanism_finding: Parent name Supertrend uses EMA21/55/100 alignment and loose EMA21 touch; native Supertrend direction/line is absent. Proposed child replaces entry grammar and lifecycle using native band state plus impulse/pullback/reclaim, not a generic indicator filter.
sample_policy: First 3 chronological saved trades per overlapping diagnostic category; no outcome-based candidate feature thresholds.
